title: Matched VAE-v3 and diffusion generator-only speed comparison
timing_boundary: fresh in-memory generator sampling only; includes VAE posterior-anchor selection, latent sampling, and decoder forward or diffusion initial-noise construction and DDIM sampling; excludes checkpoint and posterior-bank loading, warm-up, classifier-scale conversion, CPU transfer, array serialization, and manifest/metadata I/O
interpretation_boundary: generator-only spectrogram sampling on the recorded hardware
excludes checkpoint loading, conversion to classifier scale, CPU transfer, file I/O, and waveform decoding
runtime values are system measurements, not model-quality metrics
models were benchmarked sequentially rather than interleaved
repeats reuse the same deterministic sample streams, so timing variation is system variation
measurement_sequence_note: The completed diffusion benchmark was retained; VAE-v3 was remeasured afterward using the filtered 759-anchor bank. No diffusion sampling was rerun.
